timingPolicy: All algorithm event times are detector peaks in seconds. No BPM grid, snapping, or gap filling is used.

labels.policy: Possible mistakes are flagged but never silently deleted.

musicalStructure.timingPolicy: Beat and downbeat times are copied from Beat This! detector peaks. All internal bar, phrase, and section boundaries reference those downbeats; only the final open bar may end at the decoded song duration. no BPM grid, snapping, interpolation, or event-time quantization is used.

features.harmony: librosa chroma_cens, four local time bins per bar
features.timbre: 13 librosa MFCCs, robust-scaled, two local time bins per bar
features.microRhythm: librosa onset strength, 16 locally normalized phase bins per bar

recurrence.metric: cosine affinity over locally normalized 8-bar descriptors

familyThresholds.uniquePolicy: Singletons are retained as unique-low-confidence instead of forced into a repeated family.

multiScaleAgglomerative.method: Ward agglomerative clustering with temporal-chain connectivity

overlappingWindow.purpose: Detect repeated melody identities that begin midway through a non-overlapping phrase unit.

preferenceModel.timingPolicy: Scores select mature detector candidates; timestamps are never moved or quantized.
